Subject: POC prompt/log dataset collection & evaluation plan - ACME Health

Hi Alice / Tom —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps to keep the POC moving:

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Goal: integrate Redwood Inference to power clinical QA and triage workflows in the ACME provider portal.
- Primary success criteria: 1) answer accuracy on clinical QA >= 90% (on agreed eval), 2) hallucination rate < 2% on safety-critical prompts, 3) end-to-end latency < 400ms p95 for single-turn queries.
- Scope: initial POC will focus on three templates (symptom triage, medication lookup, appointment triage).

Proposed evaluation plan / next steps
1) ACME provides: a prompt set (~200 canonical prompts per template) + recent anonymized chat logs (target ~1,000 turns) and any expected outputs/labels where available. Please remove PHI; we can accept pseudonymized data.
2) Redwood will: run offline eval using our eval harness (metrics: top-1 accuracy, top-3 accuracy, hallucination rate, safety flags, latency distribution) and share a report with example failures and suggested config (model variant, quantization, batching).
3) Timeline: ideally we receive datasets by end-of-day Fri Nov 6. Redwood delivers evaluation report by Fri Nov 13. POC kickoff (inference provisioning + integration) week of Nov 16.
4) Owners: ACME data upload owner: Alice Sweeney. Redwood owners: Marissa (account), Aditya (SE lead, will run evals), Rishi (security/compliance & infra).

Attachments: POC_eval_template.xlsx (format for prompts/labels), SOW_draft.pdf (POC scope/terms).

Ask: Can you confirm you can share the prompt set and logs by EOD Nov 6 and that the data will be pseudonymized? Also flag any legal/security constraints (SFTP preferred or share Drive link).

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

--

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround and the constraints. A few practical notes to make the upload and eval smooth:

1) Schema / sample size
- Prompts: CSV with columns [prompt_id, template_type, prompt_text, expected_answer (optional), label_confidence (0-1, optional)]. Template types: triage | medication_lookup | appointment. We attached POC_eval_template.xlsx for reference.
- Chat logs: CSV/JSON lines with [session_id, turn_id, user_text, assistant_text, timestamp]. We only need ~1,000 representative turns; if you can provide session-level grouping that's helpful.

2) Minimum sample guidance
- Canonical prompts: 200 (approx 65-75 per template).
- Chat turns: ~1,000 (mix of triage + medication lookup).

3) Transfer method
- Drive link is fine; please share with aditya_rao@redwood.ai and rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai. If you prefer SFTP we can provide credentials.

4) Evaluation specifics
- Metrics we'll report: top-1 accuracy, top-3 accuracy, hallucination rate (defined as model assertions not supported by context/knowledge), precision/recall on intent labels, and latency p50/p95.
- We'll include 10-15 qualitative examples and a short remediation plan (prompt engineering + model variant recs).

5) Timeline reminder
- Upload by Nov 6 -> Redwood runs eval Nov 9-12 -> deliver report by Nov 13. If upload slips, let us know and we'll reschedule the report delivery.

Attachments: POC_eval_template.xlsx (re-sent).

Thanks — cc'ing Rishi for security checks.

Best,
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
